title: PEAK
notes: Verified in highball-db: ~30 FPS with DXVK on M1 Pro.

knownIssues.symptom: The engine's own DXVK (Kegworks v1.10.4) crashes at launch in D3D11 games that use pipeline-statistics queries (GamePort lab, M1, Heaven: 10 s).
knownIssues.cause: MoltenVK does not support VK_QUERY_TYPE_PIPELINE_STATISTICS; DXVK then resets the query pool it could not create and winevulkan aborts. Whether this game uses the query is not verified.
knownIssues.fix: GamePort's DXVK patch (Patches/dxvk, Scripts/build-dxvk.sh) makes these queries return zero and fixes the crash; Heaven D3D11 ran 5 minutes without crashing in the lab. The patched DXVK is not shipped with the engine yet. Verified with DXVK in highball-db (M1 Pro ~30 FPS); if it crashes at launch, set the renderer to dxmt.
